name: UAS Bot - ULTIMATE DEBUG (Complete diagnostic)
author: developer@ativebot.com
description: UAS Bot with complete diagnostic logging to debug extraction issues
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [[ ! -z ${UNNODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm uninstall ${UNNODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [ -f /home/container/package.json ]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install; echo "Rebuilding Canvas for container compatibility..."; /usr/local/bin/npm rebuild canvas || echo "Canvas rebuild warning (continuing anyway)"; fi; /usr/local/bin/node "/home/container/${MAIN_FILE}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# UAS Bot ULTIMATE DEBUG - Complete diagnostic installation
# Provides detailed logging for every step

apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev python3-pip libtool

# Install Canvas dependencies
apt install -y libcairo2-dev libpango1.0-dev libjpeg-dev libgif-dev librsvg2-dev pkg-config

echo -e "updating npm. please wait..."
npm install npm@latest --location=global

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "assuming user knows what they are doing have a good day."
    exit 0
fi

## add git ending if it's not on the address
if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "using anon api call"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

# ULTIMATE DEBUG: Complete diagnostic logging
echo "=== ULTIMATE DEBUG INSTALLATION START ==="
echo "DEBUG: Current working directory: $(pwd)"
echo "DEBUG: Disk space before installation:"
df -h
echo "DEBUG: Git address: ${GIT_ADDRESS}"
echo "DEBUG: Branch: ${BRANCH}"

# FORCE FRESH CLONE EVERY TIME
echo "DEBUG: Clearing server directory..."
rm -rf /mnt/server/*
rm -rf /mnt/server/.[^.]*
echo "DEBUG: Server directory cleared"
ls -la /mnt/server/

# Always clone fresh
echo "DEBUG: Starting git clone..."
if [ -z ${BRANCH} ]; then
    echo "DEBUG: cloning default branch"
    git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
else
    echo "DEBUG: cloning ${BRANCH}"
    git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
fi

echo "DEBUG: Git clone completed. Directory contents:"
ls -la /mnt/server/
echo "DEBUG: Checking for UAS directory:"
ls -la /mnt/server/uas/ 2>/dev/null || echo "UAS directory not found"

# UAS SPECIFIC: Extract from subdirectory with ULTIMATE debugging
if [ -d "uas" ]; then
    echo "=== UAS EXTRACTION DEBUG START ==="
    echo "DEBUG: UAS directory found, starting extraction..."
    echo "DEBUG: UAS directory contents BEFORE extraction:"
    ls -la uas/
    echo "DEBUG: UAS COMMANDS directory contents:"
    ls -la uas/COMMANDS/ 2>/dev/null || echo "uas/COMMANDS not found"
    echo "DEBUG: UAS UTILS directory contents:"
    ls -la uas/UTILS/ 2>/dev/null || echo "uas/UTILS not found"
    
    # Step 1: Backup .git
    echo "DEBUG: Backing up .git directory..."
    mv .git git_backup_temp
    echo "DEBUG: .git backed up successfully"
    
    # Step 2: Copy UAS contents with detailed logging
    echo "DEBUG: Starting file copy process..."
    shopt -s dotglob
    
    # Copy each directory individually with logging
    for dir in uas/*/; do
        if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
            dirname=$(basename "$dir")
            echo "DEBUG: Copying directory: $dirname"
            cp -rf "$dir" . || echo "WARNING: Failed to copy $dirname"
            echo "DEBUG: $dirname copied, checking result:"
            ls -la "$dirname/" 2>/dev/null || echo "$dirname not found after copy"
        fi
    done
    
    # Copy individual files
    for file in uas/*; do
        if [ -f "$file" ]; then
            filename=$(basename "$file")
            echo "DEBUG: Copying file: $filename"
            cp -f "$file" . || echo "WARNING: Failed to copy $filename"
        fi
    done
    
    shopt -u dotglob
    echo "DEBUG: File copy completed"
    
    # Step 3: Remove UAS directory
    echo "DEBUG: Removing source UAS directory..."
    rm -rf uas
    echo "DEBUG: UAS directory removed"
    
    # Step 4: Restore .git
    echo "DEBUG: Restoring .git directory..."
    mv git_backup_temp .git
    echo "DEBUG: .git restored"
    
    echo "=== FINAL VERIFICATION ==="
    echo "DEBUG: Final server directory contents:"
    ls -la /mnt/server/
    echo "DEBUG: Checking for key files:"
    ls -la /mnt/server/index.js 2>/dev/null || echo "index.js NOT FOUND"
    ls -la /mnt/server/package.json 2>/dev/null || echo "package.json NOT FOUND"
    echo "DEBUG: Checking for COMMANDS directory:"
    ls -la /mnt/server/COMMANDS/ 2>/dev/null || echo "COMMANDS directory NOT FOUND"
    echo "DEBUG: Checking for UTILITY directory specifically:"
    ls -la /mnt/server/COMMANDS/UTILITY/ 2>/dev/null || echo "COMMANDS/UTILITY directory NOT FOUND"
    echo "DEBUG: Checking for UTILS directory:"
    ls -la /mnt/server/UTILS/ 2>/dev/null || echo "UTILS directory NOT FOUND"
    
    # Verify file contents
    if [ -f "/mnt/server/package.json" ]; then
        echo "DEBUG: package.json size: $(wc -c < /mnt/server/package.json) bytes"
        echo "DEBUG: package.json first line:"
        head -1 /mnt/server/package.json
    fi
    
    if [ -f "/mnt/server/index.js" ]; then
        echo "DEBUG: index.js size: $(wc -c < /mnt/server/index.js) bytes"
        echo "DEBUG: index.js first line:"
        head -1 /mnt/server/index.js
    fi
    
    echo "=== UAS EXTRACTION DEBUG COMPLETE ==="
else
    echo "ERROR: UAS directory not found in cloned repository!"
    echo "Repository contents:"
    ls -la /mnt/server/
    exit 1
fi

echo "DEBUG: Installing nodejs packages..."
if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then
    /usr/local/bin/npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    echo "DEBUG: Installing dependencies from package.json..."
    /usr/local/bin/npm install --production
    echo "DEBUG: Rebuilding Canvas module..."
    /usr/local/bin/npm rebuild canvas || echo "Canvas rebuild warning (continuing anyway)"
else
    echo "ERROR: package.json not found, cannot install dependencies!"
fi

echo "=== INSTALLATION COMPLETE - FINAL STATUS ==="
echo "DEBUG: Final disk space:"
df -h
echo "DEBUG: Final directory contents:"
ls -la /mnt/server/
echo "=== ULTIMATE DEBUG INSTALLATION END ==="
exit 0
